Here is a comparison proof that tests both a shared baseline and tighter optical kerning!

Common Baseline Alignment: The lowest points of the Hero V and second V are now exactly flush with the baseline created by the E and L characters’ flat feet, following the baseline rules.

Variation A (Standard Spacing): This keeps the shared baseline while retaining the more open optical spacing from the prior layout.

Variation B (Tighter Kerning): This introduces a moderately tighter, more unified kerning cadence throughout the letterforms without sacrificing the luxurious, balanced quality.

As we complete the master wordmark, I’d love to hear which spacing rhythm appears most cohesive to you.
